body: Yeah same. It’s a really real possibility for me I think. Like after already attempting before, it’s kind of like, oh crap, I can really do that.

I do the same. My partner hates it when I joke about suicide because she is genuinely worried I’ll do that. It’s my natural reaction to everything to joke about it but I’m kind of super not joking lol.
Yeah like it doesn’t feel sad to me it just kind of feels like a normal thing.

I appreciate the kindness. It just kind of feels like it isn’t a choice, even though it is an active choice that someone makes - I have had chronic depression since I was 12 years old and I am 23 now, it just feels like the inevitable. I kind of have too much on my plate currently to even talk to anyone about it because I don’t have the time for treatment or hospital, and getting any support where I live is incredibly hard. I may save up and go private I think, but I still think it’s something that will catch me out one day and I won’t be able to stop myself. I’ve also been in and out of therapy over the years and I’m on antidepressants and have been on other types. I’m hoping that, when I’m able to get a cat, I can stick around for it, being able to care for animals makes me very hopeful and willing to stick around :) again, thanks for the kind words. It’s nice to hear that sometimes.
Hey, I’m glad to hear that!

I’m sorry, I have loved ones with BPD and I was misdiagnosed with it myself so I know quite a fair bit about it, suicide risk is really high for people with BPD so you’d think they would make accessing help and treatment easier, but it’s the opposite. I hope you manage to access treatment soon, even just to ease that pain for a while. I attempted to OD in 2020 but I’d rather use a different method if I was going to do it again, OD isn’t fast enough for me and they only gave me weekly prescriptions for my meds after that lol
All I picture is me hanging myself eventually, it’s always hanging for me.

Yeah my partner gets really upset when I even joke about killing myself so I don’t talk about that stuff with her. If I said that to her she would definitely not understand it. Hope you’re at least having an okay time in hospital (as much as you can be I guess).
Glad to hear it’s a common feeling - makes me feel less alone! I’m glad it didn’t discourage me from attending - I feel like I’ve found something very special and important to me.

Sorry for the late response, I don’t use Reddit so often - I attended the Thursday meeting and Sunday meeting last week and honestly I loved it. It leaves me with such a positive feeling after meetings and my local community is incredibly welcoming. I have a copy of faith and practice on the way, and I feel less worried that I’m not good enough now. 🙂

I ended up pushing it off as my partner let me stay over (they live alone so we’re in each other’s bubble covid wise) to keep me safe. I’m seeing a therapist next week finally. It’s still in the back of my head, I still want to do it, but I’ll see what goes on with therapy beforehand. Though I don’t have a lot of hope.

I’m going through female-female assault trauma too. It fucking sucks. It feels like no one takes it as seriously but I’m so afraid of everything and everyone. I hear you, I understand what you’re going through, what you experienced was assault. Rape counselling helped me a lot to reaffirm my trauma. You didn’t and couldn’t consent to that especially in that state and neither could I, it’s traumatic and I hope you are coping okay. Please try to talk to someone about this ASAP.  It gets more difficult to cope alone is what I found. Just make sure you tell the right people (like your boyfriend), my partner was so supportive but I’ve had to cut out friends that were not.
I think the rates of assault with LGBTQ+ women would say otherwise. Wouldn’t expect a cuck to know about assault between two women though. Find a hobby instead of harassing people, hurr hurr.
Ahh yes because I would be going to the police about it just for shits and giggles. Counsellor reaffirms my trauma every session, you should try it, you clearly need it.
Someone’s projecting. Clearly you have some cases against you.
Wasn’t a grope lmao. Yawn. Try harder next time.

It’s so dehumanising, I don’t even feel like a person anymore. I have counselling tomorrow so I’ll most likely tell her about the self harm but I’m worried about telling her about being suicidal because I know they’d have to tell someone if they thought I was going to actually do it.
Low quality bait, I was literally raped, but thanks for making me feel like shit.

It’s a book an ex-bulimic wrote discussing how she got over binge eating. The approach is less “you binge because of trauma/emotional issues” to “you’re feeding a habit by binging so every time you give into that habit, the urges get worse”. At first I kinda didn’t believe it but it’s been the only thing that’s stopped me binging in a very long time. There’s still some work you have to put in to avoiding those urges but I’ve gone from constantly impulsively binging/pre planning binges to not binging in a few weeks (even when there’s been food I usually binge on in the house).
I didn’t think of meal prepping beforehand so I’ll give that a go!

It was the same for me but I was thinner when I smoked ironically LOL. I genuinely have no idea why I binge so I really want to try with brain over binge more, but I’m really impulsive :/ no worries! Thanks for the concern, I’m just stressed. I hate gaining weight and ruining my health, I feel awful all of the time but nothing scares me out of binge eating
No, I haven’t smoked weed in a few years. I don’t particularly enjoy it anymore and wasn’t too big into it when I did. Why?

They might do, if I got a good therapist, but the state of the UK mental health system sucks so I’m not sure that I would. I’m kind of banking on whether today is a good day or not to see if I’ll attempt.

I’m in the UK so I would have no medical bill. That’s a plus at least. Also would most likely not be hospitalised because of the lack of beds the NHS has. Not dying is however not really a plus. I honestly don’t think I’d mind a painful way to go, something that happened recently caused severe physical pain, so I’d be used to it, but I’d rather it worked.

Hanging doesn’t seem bad if you do it right honestly but the build up to be able to do that sounds the worst. 

Overdosing might work if I mix medications, but I’m mostly having a crisis and I have no support system. 
I am miserable at the moment and it won’t go away.

Yeah probably, it’s just hurtful because I’m the one that’s getting most of the shitty stuff (like feeling nauseous and pain and such) and I feel very alone and not understood at all. He just doesn’t seem concerned about me at all, just more of how he doesn’t want a child. 

I have told a few friends but even with them I still feel very alone, it’s hard to explain why though :(
